name: HOLDINGS_ATOMIC_WRITE_20261030
comment: ANCHOR: HOLDINGS_ATOMIC_WRITE_20261030 — DSN-20261030: disk ENOSPC during a deploy truncated
holdings.json (and ticker_snapshot_latest.json / finviz_quote_cache.json) to 0 bytes because two write
paths were non-atomic (truncate-then-write). The fix routes both through scripts/lib/atomic_json_store.
atomic_write_bytes (temp + fsync + os.replace): the repricer holdings refresh and the schwab_position_sync
backup restore. Hermetic: tmp_path + monkeypatched os.replace/os.fsync and side-effect writers; no live
holdings.json, no broker, no network, no DB.
